properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute before rate limiting applies.

properties.name: rabbitmq.queue.user-created
properties.description: Name of the RabbitMQ queue that receives a message whenever a new user signs up.

properties.name: github.client-id
properties.description: OAuth Client ID for the GitHub OAuth App used for GitHub sign up / sign in.

properties.name: github.client-secret
properties.description: OAuth Client Secret for the GitHub OAuth App used for GitHub sign up / sign in.

properties.name: cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary account cloud name, used for uploading and serving profile pictures.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key for the account used to upload profile pictures.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret for the account used to upload profile pictures.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify the app's own JWT access tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Lifetime of an issued JWT access token, in seconds.

properties.name: app.url
properties.description: Base URL of the client application, used to build links in verification and password-reset emails.

properties.name: google.client-id
properties.description: OAuth Client ID for the Google Sign-In app used to verify Google ID tokens on sign up / sign in.

properties.name: facebook.app-id
properties.description: Facebook App ID used to verify Facebook access tokens on sign up / sign in.

properties.name: facebook.app-secret
properties.description: Facebook App Secret used to verify Facebook access tokens on sign up / sign in.

properties.name: internal.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret other microservices send as the X-Internal-Api-Key header on Feign calls into this service.

properties.name: app.storage.mode
properties.description: LOCAL saves documents in app.storage.root. NETWORK saves them on a NAS share (SMB or NFS) that is already mounted on this server.

properties.name: app.storage.root
properties.description: LOCAL mode only. Folder on the server where collector application documents are saved. Created if it does not exist. No default.

properties.name: app.storage.network.protocol
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. SMB or NFS.

properties.name: app.storage.network.host
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. IP address or host name of the NAS. Used to check that the right share is mounted, never to connect.

properties.name: app.storage.network.share
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. SMB: the share name. NFS: the exported path, for example /volume1/garbigo.

properties.name: app.storage.network.mount-path
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. Folder where the share is mounted on this server. No default.

properties.name: app.storage.network.directory
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. Folder inside the share that holds the documents.

properties.name: app.storage.network.require-mount
properties.description: NETWORK mode only. When true, the service refuses to read or write unless the share is really mounted, so files never land on the local disk by mistake.

properties.name: app.storage.applications-folder
properties.description: Sub folder of the storage root that holds one folder per collector application.

properties.name: app.storage.restrict-permissions
properties.description: Make new folders and files readable only by the user running the service.

properties.name: collector-application.staff-page-path
properties.description: Front end route staff open from the application resubmitted email. The application id is appended.

properties.name: collector-application.reapply-cooldown-days
properties.description: Days a rejected applicant must wait before applying again. 0 means no wait.

properties.name: collector-application.max-attempts
properties.description: Most collector applications one person may make in total. 0 means no limit.

properties.name: collector-application.max-file-mb
properties.description: Largest document an applicant can upload, in megabytes.

properties.name: collector-application.review-days
properties.description: Number of working days promised to applicants in emails and next-step messages.

properties.name: collector-application.page-path
properties.description: Path on the client application that the buttons in collector application emails open, appended to app.url.
